ALTER TABLE personal_teacher
    ADD CONSTRAINT personal_teacher_id_student_unique UNIQUE (id, student_id);

CREATE TABLE teacher_decision (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    causation_id VARCHAR(128),
    teaching_mode VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    context_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    context_id VARCHAR(255),
    strategy VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    hint_level SMALLINT,
    reason_code VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    reason_summary VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id)
        REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id),
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(correlation_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (teaching_mode IN ('lesson', 'practice', 'homework', 'project', 'exam', 'sandbox')),
    CHECK (context_type IN ('general', 'lesson', 'lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    CHECK ((context_type = 'general' AND context_id IS NULL) OR (context_type <> 'general' AND context_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(context_id) <> '')),
    CHECK (action IN ('respond', 'ask_question', 'give_hint', 'intervene', 'recommend', 'stay_silent')),
    CHECK (hint_level IS NULL OR hint_level BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
    CHECK (action <> 'give_hint' OR hint_level IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (btrim(strategy) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(reason_code) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(reason_summary) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(policy_version) <> '')
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_decision_student_created_idx
    ON teacher_decision (student_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX teacher_decision_correlation_idx
    ON teacher_decision (correlation_id);

CREATE TABLE teacher_outbox (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    subject VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0),
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    correlation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    causation_id VARCHAR(128),
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    payload JSONB NOT NULL,
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    locked_by VARCHAR(128),
    locked_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_error VARCHAR(2000),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CHECK (btrim(subject) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(correlation_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'event_id' = event_id::TEXT),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'event_type' = subject),
    CHECK ((payload ->> 'schema_version')::INTEGER = schema_version),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'student_id' = student_id),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'correlation_id' = correlation_id),
    CHECK (payload ->> 'causation_id' = COALESCE(causation_id, '')),
    CHECK ((locked_by IS NULL) = (locked_until IS NULL))
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_outbox_pending_idx
    ON teacher_outbox (next_attempt_at, occurred_at)
    WHERE published_at IS NULL;
